episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Andy's 30th birthday lunch is interrupted by a shocking act of violence. After her mom's stunning response goes viral, a threat emerges in their home.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Forced to flee in the night, Andy prepares to navigate the long journey to Maine without a GPS, while Laura asks Gordon for help with a delicate matter.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Feeling caught in a web of lies, Andy searches for answers on her own. Laura sends a message on live TV and soon finds her past catching up with her.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Andy probes possible connections to her mother, including an inmate and a pharmaceutical CEO. Despite lingering threats, Laura looks for a way out.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Andy uncovers more details about her family's history and reaches out to Mike, while Laura begins her new life and tries to track down her daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Andy attempts to retrieve a suitcase from Mike's hotel room as her mother reconnects with people from her past. A bittersweet reunion is cut short.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Andy heads to a familiar place with a companion as memories of her childhood come flooding back. Flashbacks reveal the Quellers' struggles after Oslo.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: During an intense confrontation, Andy comes to a frightening realization. A closer look at the horrific events in Oslo brings more truths to light.
